message: esbuild has install scripts and npm 11.6.0 (packageManager in package.json) runs them, but depcurfew.json does not allow it
fix: Add esbuild to installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json, and keep optional dependencies installed (no omit=optional in .npmrc, no --omit=optional or --no-optional on the install): esbuild works without its install script then. Then make npm stop running dependency install scripts (run depcurfew apply and follow its warnings)
